title: NEXT-CODEX-POST-REDTEAM - Phase B blocking finding convergence hardening
purpose: Harden Phase B so a reviewer NO_GO or REQUEST_CHANGES finding classified as blocking can never be persisted or resumed as deferred non-blocking bridge convergence, and so post-Phase-A control-packet line-reference drift is checked before final pytest, supervisor, or commit handoff.
evidence_command: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 -m pytest -q mu/tests/tools/test_phase_b_executor.py -k "blocking_finding_convergence or line_ref" --tb=short && PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 -m pytest -q mu/tests/tools/test_check_control_packet_line_refs.py --tb=short && python3 -m py_compile mu/tools/executors/phase_b_executor.py
evidence_delta: (1) Phase B rejects or re-routes any bridge_converged checkpoint whose deferred/non-blocking finding state contains an effective blocking finding. (2) A NO_GO or REQUEST_CHANGES bridge review with blocking findings cannot advance to final pytest, supervisor, or commit handoff without a successful bridge-fix implementer pass and a fresh bridge review. (3) Phase B runs the existing control-packet line-ref lint on the governing packet after bridge convergence and before final pytest/supervisor, catching post-Phase-A packet drift.
progress_proof_before: During structural-numbers-rationals-2026-06-19, the round-4 rendered bridge review recorded Decision: NO_GO for a POLICY_BOUND control-packet line-reference finding, while Phase B still advanced to final pytest/COMMIT_GO after operator doc-only unblock; this exposed a missing deterministic guard between reviewer blocking truth, deferred non-blocking state, and bridge_converged finalization.
progress_proof_after: Focused Phase B regressions prove that blocking reviewer findings and control-packet line-reference lint failures cannot be silently carried into bridge_converged, final pytest, supervisor, or commit handoff.
scope_summary: Pipeline hardening only. This wave may modify Phase B executor logic, focused Phase B executor tests, this control packet/config, TASKS.md via the launcher tracker-note builder, and the generated L4 indicator artifact.

work_items: Add a deterministic guard in Phase B before bridge_converged finalization that reclassifies or validates accumulated deferred/non-blocking findings and fails closed if any effective disposition is blocking.

Ensure REQUEST_CHANGES or NO_GO bridge reviews with blocking findings checkpoint bridge_fix_pending and invoke the implementer, and cannot continue to final pytest, supervisor, or commit handoff without a subsequent clean bridge review.
Add a pre-finalization control-packet line-reference lint using the existing checker logic for reports/control_plane packets after bridge convergence and before final pytest/supervisor.
Add focused regressions proving a saved bridge_converged state containing a blocking finding in all_non_blocking does not resume to commit_ready.
Add focused regressions proving post-bridge governing-packet line-reference drift halts or routes as blocking before final pytest/supervisor.
Keep the fix in pipeline/control-plane tooling only; do not touch runtime, substrate, seed, JS production, or structural-number test semantics.
Run the evidence command and collect the L4 indicator artifact.
constraints: Use the launcher and dispatcher path; do not hand-commit this wave.
Do not modify runtime, substrate, seed, registry, JS production, StructuralNumbers gates, or merged rational-wave artifacts except through test fixtures.
Do not weaken reviewer finding classification, severity floors, or governance downgrade rules.
Do not remove the ability to defer genuine non-blocking DOC_ACCURACY or POLICY_BOUND findings.
Do not add a second line-ref checker; reuse tools/checks/check_control_packet_line_refs.py or its existing callable logic.
Keep tests focused and deterministic; avoid broad end-to-end pipeline runs inside unit tests.
stop_conditions: Stop as DEFECT if Phase B cannot distinguish effective blocking findings from deferred non-blocking findings without changing reviewer schema.
Stop as POLICY_BOUND if the fix would make current non-blocking DOC_ACCURACY deferral impossible.
Stop as INTEGRATION if the line-ref lint cannot be applied to post-Phase-A control packets without duplicating checker logic.
Do not proceed to commit without the configured evidence command passing and the indicator artifact collected.
acceptance_criteria: A bridge_converged resume state with any effective blocking finding in all_non_blocking cannot reach commit_ready.
A NO_GO or REQUEST_CHANGES bridge review with blocking findings takes the bridge-fix path or fails closed at max rounds; it never becomes deferred-only convergence.
A control packet with a post-bridge code file:line reference is rejected before final pytest, supervisor, or commit handoff.
Existing genuine non-blocking finding deferral remains supported.
request_for_agent: Implement the Phase B blocking-finding convergence hardening through the pipeline-owned Phase A and Phase B path only, using Codex for implementer and reviewer. Preserve non-blocking deferral for genuine non-blocking findings, but fail closed when any effective blocking finding or post-Phase-A control-packet line-ref drift would otherwise reach bridge_converged, final pytest, supervisor, or commit handoff.
